name: Keepa
summary: Amazon product price and sales-rank history, product search, best-seller lists, categories and seller data across 11 Amazon marketplaces.

api_key.description: A Keepa private API access key (keepa.com > API). Sent as the key query parameter.

notes: Billed in tokens from a per-minute refill. Every answer carries tokensLeft, refillIn (ms), refillRate (per minute) and tokensConsumed; when tokens run out the API answers 503 until they refill.
Prices are integers in the locale's smallest unit (4900 = $49.00; in Japan 4900 = 4900 yen); -1 means no offer at that time.
Times in csv histories are Keepa minutes: unix_ms = (keepa_minute + 21564000) * 60000.
domain is a number, not a hostname: 1 is amazon.com.
Product finder, deals, lightning deals and product tracking (which writes) are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Get products by ASIN
endpoints.summary: Product objects with price, rank and review history, optionally stats, offers and buy box data.

domain.description: Amazon locale: 1 com, 2 co.uk, 3 de, 4 fr, 5 co.jp, 6 ca, 8 it, 9 es, 10 in, 11 com.mx, 12 com.br.

asin.description: 1-100 ASINs, comma separated (at most 20 with offers).

stats.description: Add a stats field (current, min/max and weighted mean prices) over the last N days (e.g. 90), or between two dates as 'start,end' (ISO 8601 such as 2015-12-31).

update.description: Force a refresh when the stored data is older than this many hours. Default 1; 0 means live data and may cost an extra token.

history.description: 1 includes the csv price history; 0 leaves it out for a faster, smaller answer.

offers.description: Number of marketplace offers to retrieve. Costs extra tokens; with offers at most 20 ASINs per call.

rating.description: 1 includes rating and review-count history even without offers.

buybox.description: 1 includes all buy box data in the product and stats.

notes: Offers and live data (update 0) cost extra tokens; tokensConsumed in the answer gives the charge.

endpoints.name: Get products by UPC, EAN or ISBN
endpoints.summary: Product objects for product codes; one code can map to several ASINs.

domain.description: Amazon locale: 1 com, 2 co.uk, 3 de, 4 fr, 5 co.jp, 6 ca, 8 it, 9 es, 10 in, 11 com.mx, 12 com.br.

code.description: UPC, EAN or ISBN-13 codes, comma separated, up to 100.

stats.description: Add a stats field (current, min/max and weighted mean prices) over the last N days (e.g. 90), or between two dates as 'start,end' (ISO 8601 such as 2015-12-31).

update.description: Force a refresh when the stored data is older than this many hours. Default 1; 0 means live data and may cost an extra token.

history.description: 1 includes the csv price history; 0 leaves it out for a faster, smaller answer.

offers.description: Number of marketplace offers to retrieve. Costs extra tokens; with offers at most 20 ASINs per call.

notes: Same path as keepa.product with code instead of asin; never send both.

endpoints.name: Search products
endpoints.summary: Amazon products matching keywords, as product objects or just ASINs.

domain.description: Amazon locale: 1 com, 2 co.uk, 3 de, 4 fr, 5 co.jp, 6 ca, 8 it, 9 es, 10 in, 11 com.mx, 12 com.br.

page.description: 0-9, 10 results each; keep other parameters identical. Without page the first 40 results come back.

stats.description: Add a stats field (current, min/max and weighted mean prices) over the last N days (e.g. 90), or between two dates as 'start,end' (ISO 8601 such as 2015-12-31).

update.description: Force a refresh when the stored data is older than this many hours. Default 1; 0 means live data and may cost an extra token.

history.description: 1 includes the csv price history; 0 leaves it out for a faster, smaller answer.

notes: At most 50 results per search term.

endpoints.name: Search categories
endpoints.summary: Amazon category nodes whose name matches keywords.

domain.description: Amazon locale: 1 com, 2 co.uk, 3 de, 4 fr, 5 co.jp, 6 ca, 8 it, 9 es, 10 in, 11 com.mx, 12 com.br.

term.description: Space-separated keywords, all must match, each at least 3 characters.

endpoints.name: Look up categories
endpoints.summary: Category objects by node id, optionally with their parent tree.

domain.description: Amazon locale: 1 com, 2 co.uk, 3 de, 4 fr, 5 co.jp, 6 ca, 8 it, 9 es, 10 in, 11 com.mx, 12 com.br.

category.description: Category node id, or up to 10 comma separated (same token cost).

endpoints.name: Get best sellers
endpoints.summary: ASIN list of the most popular products by sales in a category or product group.

domain.description: Amazon locale: 1 com, 2 co.uk, 3 de, 4 fr, 5 co.jp, 6 ca, 8 it, 9 es, 10 in, 11 com.mx, 12 com.br.

category.description: A category node id, or a websiteDisplayGroupName (product group).

endpoints.name: Get sellers
endpoints.summary: Amazon marketplace seller objects by seller id, optionally with the ASINs they list.

domain.description: Amazon locale: 1 com, 2 co.uk, 3 de, 4 fr, 5 co.jp, 6 ca, 8 it, 9 es, 10 in, 11 com.mx, 12 com.br.

seller.description: Seller id, or up to 100 comma separated (one id when storefront is used).

storefront.description: 1 adds the seller's listed ASINs (up to 100,000); extra tokens only when data exists.

notes: A seller that is not found consumes no tokens.

endpoints.name: Get top sellers
endpoints.summary: Seller ids of the most rated Amazon marketplace sellers.

domain.description: Amazon locale: 1 com, 2 co.uk, 3 de, 4 fr, 5 co.jp, 6 ca, 8 it, 9 es, 10 in, 11 com.mx, 12 com.br.
